title: 12th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/12/1/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 7/1/2025 to 9/1/2025).

Written question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Dr Abdulla Khaleel: Article 41(b) of the Foreign Service Act caps the political appointees described in Article 41(a)(1) and (4) at 20% of total Foreign Service staff, and the limited information available suggests this has been far exceeded; what is the actual number?

Written question from the same MP to the Foreign Minister: Article 7(d) of the Foreign Service Act makes it the minister's responsibility to advise the President on recognising states and establishing or severing diplomatic relations, and to implement the President's decisions; why has the decision of 2 June 2024 to ban entry to the Maldives on Israeli passports not been implemented?

Written question from the same MP to the Foreign Minister: Article 11 of the Foreign Service Act requires the Foreign Secretary to be appointed from Foreign Service staff serving as "Secretary" in the executive staff category, with the experience and capability for the post and at least 10 years' service in the ministry; does the person appointed as Foreign Secretary meet these conditions?

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of a Permanent Representative of the Maldives to the UN Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (UN ESCAP), under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021), is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's matter on appointing non-resident ambassadors of the Maldives to foreign countries, under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021), is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the matter of removing the Vice President of the Maldives Broadcasting Commission from membership of the Commission is sent to the relevant standing committee under Rule 232(b) of the Standing Orders.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, put three written questions to the Foreign Minister on political appointees, the unenforced Israeli passport ban and the Foreign Secretary's qualifications, and sent diplomatic nominations and a Broadcasting Commission removal to committees.
